results.rationale: IVD unambiguously ranks Tomcat01 as initiator (Copeland 5). It shows near-onset emitter exception logs (GC Allocation Failure) and multiple internal signals (cpu, memory). Other Tomcats are ambiguous; gateways and storage are victims or reactive dependencies. Late metric spikes are unreliable. The downstream test confirms Tomcat01's anomalies precede all other components. No other candidate has independent emitter exceptions at onset.
uncertainties: Exact mechanism (GC pressure) is inferred from logs but could be secondary to another fault; however, IVD initiator status and absence of alternative strong candidates support this.

ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.

ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.

ivd.interpretation: IVD uses pairwise tournament (Copeland score) to identify the initiator vs victim among source candidates. The initiator is the candidate whose anomaly is least explainable by others and most explanatory for others. Do not select a candidate labeled as 'victim' over one labeled as 'initiator'.
